svg.text: ROUND 356 · PYTORCH .TRANSPOSE().CONTIGUOUS() & .RESHAPE() COPY EXPLOSION VS. STRIDE-AWARE BSHD
Why .transpose(1,2).contiguous() Wastes 24 GB/Layer & How Stride-Aware Views Fix It
[B=4, S=32,768, H=64, D=128] BF16 (1.00 GB/Tensor) · Zero-Copy Stride Contract (stride(-1) == 1) & In-Place Fused RoPE
⛔ Tier 1 & Tier 2: 24.0 GB/Layer aten::copy_ Waste
1. Tier 1: .transpose(1,2).contiguous() + cat RoPE (7.16 ms)
• Permuting [B, S, H, D] -> [B, H, S, D] with .contiguous() +
torch.cat((-x2, x1)) in RoPE + post-attn .contiguous() moves
24.00 GB of pure HBM copies/layer & pins +4.00 GB extra HBM!
2. Tier 2: Blind .reshape() Silent Copy Trap (12.0 GB Waste)
• Replacing .view() with .reshape() on a transposed tensor
(attn_out.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, S, -1)) silently calls
.contiguous() under the hood, allocating a new 1.00 GB tensor!
3. Tier 3: Innermost Dimension Transpose (stride(-1) != 1)
• Calling k.transpose(-2, -1) breaks stride(-1) == 1, forcing
Flash/SDPA wrappers to secretly allocate a contiguous copy!
✅ Tier 4: Native [B, S, H, D] + In-Place RoPE (0.18 ms)
1. Keep Native [B, S, H, D] (or Zero-Copy Strided View)
• q = q_proj(x).view(B, S, H, D) -> directly feed FlashAttention
in [B, S, H, D], or pass q.transpose(1, 2) WITHOUT .contiguous()
to SDPA (since stride(-1) == 1 is preserved across outer dims!)
2. Pre-Allocated Output Buffer + In-Place Strided RoPE
• Apply RoPE in-place on [B, S, H, D] via Triton/CUDA kernel
• FlashAttention writes directly into [B, S, H, D] output buffer
so out.view(B, S, H * D) is a 100% zero-copy metadata op!
3. Quantified End-to-End Gains ([4, 32768, 64, 128] BF16)
• Copy Traffic: 24.00 GB/layer -> 0.00 GB/layer (-4.00 GB HBM)
• Layout + RoPE Latency: 7.16 ms -> 0.18 ms (39.8x speedup!)
